description: 🍊 Potent Vitamin C & Ferulic Acid Synergy: Formulated with stable Vitamin C and antioxidants to boost radiance and protect skin from daily environmental damage.
✨ Fades Dark Spots & Hyperpigmentation: Targets stubborn acne marks, sun spots, and uneven skin texture for a visibly clearer, luminous complexion.
💧 Hydrating & Non-Sticky Formula: Water-light, fast-absorbing texture that penetrates deeply without leaving any greasy or tacky feel.
🛡️ Collagen & Youth Repair: Boosts collagen synthesis to improve skin elasticity, firm up fine lines, and fight early signs of aging.
🌿 Suitable for All Skin Types: Gentle, non-irritating formulation ideal for normal, oily, dry, and combination skin types.
Cleanse: Thoroughly wash your face with a mild face wash and gently pat dry.
Dispense: Apply 2–3 drops of Deconstruct Vitamin C Serum directly onto your forehead, cheeks, and neck.
Absorb: Gently pat and press the serum into your skin using your fingertips. (Avoid rubbing aggressively).
Moisturize & Protect: Allow 1–2 minutes for absorption, then follow up with your favorite moisturizer. Always apply Sunscreen (SPF 30+) during daytime!
Sun Protection Required: Vitamin C can increase sun sensitivity. Always wear broad-spectrum sunscreen during the day while using this product.
Patch Test First: Apply 1 drop on your inner wrist or behind your ear 24 hours before first full-face application.
Storage: Store in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight. Keep the bottle tightly closed after use to prevent oxidation (darkening of color).
Avoid Active Conflicts: Avoid using simultaneously in the same routine with strong exfoliating acids (AHAs/BHAs) or Retinol unless your skin is acclimated.
